info.description: REST API for the Mafia Night game platform.
info.title: Mafia Night API

post.description: Authenticates an admin user and returns a JWT token.

get.description: Retrieves all role templates. Optionally filter by player_count.

post.description: Creates a new role template. Requires admin authentication.

get.description: Retrieves a single role template with its role assignments.
get.summary: Get a role template by ID

delete.description: Deletes a role template. Requires admin authentication.

patch.description: Updates an existing role template. Requires admin authentication.

get.description: Retrieves all available roles in the game.

post.description: Creates a new game role. Requires admin authentication.

delete.description: Deletes a role. Requires admin authentication.

patch.description: Updates an existing role. Requires admin authentication.

get.description: Retrieves all admin users. Requires admin authentication.

post.description: Creates a new admin user. Requires admin authentication.

get.description: Retrieves an admin user by ID. Requires admin authentication.

delete.description: Deletes an admin user. Requires admin authentication.

patch.description: Updates an admin user. Requires admin authentication.

post.description: Changes the password for an admin user. Requires admin authentication.
Creates a new Mafia game session. The caller becomes the moderator.

get.description: Retrieves a game by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes a game. Only the moderator can delete.

patch.description: Updates the status of a game. Only the moderator can update.

post.description: Randomly assigns roles to all players. Only the moderator can trigger this.
Allows a player to join a game by name.

get.description: Retrieves all players in a game.

delete.description: Removes a player from the game.
delete.summary: Remove a player from a game

get.description: Retrieves the role assigned to a specific player.
Returns all player-role assignments for a game. Only the moderator can view this.
get.summary: Get all role assignments in a game

get.description: Retrieves all role templates. Optionally filter by player_count.
Retrieves a single role template with its role assignments.
get.summary: Get a role template by ID

get.description: Retrieves all available roles in the game.
Retrieves a single role by its slug identifier.
